plan.title: design-critique comment lead: model then role triage|critic|parent

narratives.Description: Keep #3628 line 1 model slug. Add line 2 role from a closed set. Role is not a label.
narratives.Origin: GitHub issue #3646. Zero comments at ingest. Body is SoT. Pair note on #3640 comment 5387172545. Parent #3434. Residual of #3628.
narratives.Overview: First line remains model: <slug>. Second line is role: triage|critic|parent. Same two lines on Stop 4 retry critics and on #3640 auto-posted table / synthesis-accepted (role: parent). Do not put role in an issue label. Do not replace the model line. narratives.UserStory: As a later reader, I want the first two lines of each design-critique comment to name model and role so I can tell triage vs critic vs parent under one GitHub login.
narratives.When: When the contract and brief template require line 1 model and line 2 role from the closed set, tests pin both lines, ISSUE_LABELS still forbids author/role chips, #3640 auto-posts are specified as role: parent, and CHANGELOG has an Unreleased line.
narratives.LockedDecisions: Closed role set: triage, critic, parent. No new roles in v1. No role chips (#3642). Do not implement exclusive-chip remaining-set write (#3642) or walk/auto-stamp semantics (#3640) except that auto-posted comments MUST use this lead. Sequence after #3642 lands.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Contract + brief template. Content-contract test. Thin skill pointer. ISSUE_LABELS already-forbid author/role chips stays. CHANGELOG. Closes #3646. After #3642, before #3640.
narratives.OriginDivergence: No comments at ingest. Pair 5387172545 lives on #3640.
